:::{#exr-orthogonal-vectors-practice}
#### Choosing $c$ to make two vectors orthogonal

Principal component analysis describes data along [orthogonal vectors](#def-orthogonal-vectors),
so testing for orthogonality comes up often.
For $c \in \reals$,
let

$$
\vx = \sbmat{2 \\ c \\ 1},
\qquad
\vy = \sbmat{1 \\ 3 \\ -5}.
$$

Find the value of $c$ for which $\vx \perp \vy$.

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

By @def-orthogonal-vectors,
solve $\vx \cdot \vy = 0$ for $c$,
using @def-dot-product.

:::

:::
